_note: VFX's meteor trail (docs/vfx/meteor-trail.md): a fighter's own burn, a ribbon along his real path that glows through the air and cools in the world. Read by render/vfx/meteor.gd and meteor_view.gd, never by the sim, and drawn only while the hub's `meteor_enabled` switch is on (off by default). burn = air(altitude) x smoothstep(burn_from, burn_full, speed) x cool, where `cool` is the rule of cool: the tier, the form step and the situations below. Widths are clamped in PIXELS (floors and ceilings are for a 1,280-wide screen and grow with width) so the trail never thins to nothing at a wide zoom. A fighter's look is COMPOSED: his lane colour and beam flavour (energy.json), then this file's `default` row, the row for his roster id (lower case), its `forms` entry for his form step, then every `situations` entry whose condition holds ({read: a dotted path off the fighter, is / min / max, set: any key of the row}). A new fighter is a data row. Rows empress and cyborg are rows only: their kits are parked.

profiles._note: Two sets Orb judges in the private preview (the page word ?meteor=quiet or ?meteor=loud; ?meteor=1 is quiet). `quiet` is the base `frame` as shipped: a ribbon that is wide on screen is dimmed (wide_k 0.3). `loud` keeps a wide ribbon at full strength (wide_k 1.0) and dims it instead only while the camera sweeps across the world fast (pan_k 0.1 from 0.6 to 3 screen widths a second): the flash reading follows motion as well as area. Flash readings of the scripted launch, normal and reduced, are in docs/vfx/meteor-trail.md section 12.

flight._note: The flight lines (docs/vfx/flight-lines.md; Game Design docs/design/rule-of-cool-map.md section 1): the meteor ribbon laid by a fighter flying near flat out, with a strength of its own (`tier` by tier 1 to 4, plus `form_step` per form step up to `form_max` more, 1 at most), none at tier 1 or 2. The speed ramps from `from_k` of flat out (the sim's own: SimFighter.flightSpeed at the full traversal boost; `flat_out` here is only the fallback where there is no state to read) to full at it, and needs the stick held (`hold_min`) for `hold_s`. Length x`len_ground` on the ground to x`len_high` from `alt_high` up, a thin-air line `thin_w` as wide. `dev_bh` is how far (in body heights) a row with fewer knots may stray from his true path before a knot is laid; `settle_s` how long a drawn-tight line takes to straighten. A row's own `fl_*` keys (gaps, rim, knots, settle ...) apply only while the lines are on.

protagonist._source: docs/vfx/meteor-trail.md section 5: broad and rolling, bubble rings; the beam's own boil pattern

rival._source: docs/vfx/meteor-trail.md section 5: exact and cold, a hard needle with lances and facets; lasts 1.3 times longer

empress._source: docs/vfx/meteor-trail.md section 5 (parked kit): a taut wire arc with a gold rim. A row only: she is not on the roster

cyborg._source: docs/vfx/meteor-trail.md section 5 (parked kit): broken, with gaps fixed in the world and sparks. A row only: he is not on the roster
